err: error TS2742: The inferred type of Foo cannot be named without a reference to some-pkg. This is likely not portable. A type annotation is necessary.

err: go: no such tool <STR>

err: //go:linkname must refer to declared function or variable

err: docker: invalid reference format: repository name must be lowercase

err: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named bs4

err: Error: export const fetchCache is not allowed in a Client Component.

err: error TS2339: Property foo does not exist on type Bar.

fix.b: The property is missing on the type. Add it to the interface, use a type guard, or narrow before access. Distinct from TS2304 Cannot find name.

err: error TS2322: Type string is not assignable to type number.

fix.b: The value type does not match the target. Coerce, widen the annotation, or change the source type. Distinct from TS2345 argument mismatch.

err: error TS7006: Parameter x implicitly has an any type.

err: error TS2571: Object is of type unknown.

err: error TS2532: Object is possibly undefined.

err: error TS1497: The import.meta meta-property is not allowed in files which will build into CommonJS output.

err: TypeError [ERR_INVALID_URL]: Invalid URL

err: Error: export const maxDuration is not allowed in a Client Component.

err: go: cannot find GOROOT directory: <PATH>

err: module github.com/foo/bar@v1.<N>.<N> found, but does not contain package github.com/foo/bar/pkg

err: go: -race is not supported on windows/arm64

err: Error: locator.click: intercepts pointer events

err: Error: net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET at <URL>

err: Error: net::ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE at <URL>

err: Error: net::ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS at <URL>

err: RuntimeError: cannot reuse already awaited coroutine

err: error TS2345: Argument of type string is not assignable to parameter of type number.

fix.b: The call site type does not match the parameter. Coerce, change the argument, or widen the callee. Distinct from TS2322 assignment.

err: error TS2554: Expected <N> arguments, but got <N>.

fix.b: The call is missing a required argument. Pass the extra arg or make the parameter optional. Distinct from TS2345 type mismatch.

err: error TS2531: Object is possibly null.

fix.b: Guard with a null check, optional chaining, or a non-null assertion after a check. Distinct from TS2532 possibly undefined.

err: error TS7031: Binding element x implicitly has an any type.

fix.b: noImplicitAny is on. Annotate the destructured binding or the source type. Distinct from TS7006 parameter implicit any.

err: error TS2454: Variable x is used before being assigned.

err: error TS2564: Property foo has no initializer and is not definitely assigned in the constructor.

fix.b: Initialize the property, assign it in the constructor, or add !. Distinct from TS2454 used before assigned.

err: error TS2693: Foo only refers to a type, but is being used as a value here.

err: error TS2741: Property foo is missing in type <STR> but required in type Bar.

err: error TS7016: Could not find a declaration file for module foo. node_modules/foo/index.js implicitly has an any type.

err: error TS1208: Cannot compile namespaces when the --isolatedModules flag is provided.

err: TypeError [ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE]: The argument path must be a string, Uint8Array, or URL without null bytes. Received

err: Error [ERR_SOCKET_CLOSED]: Socket is closed

fix.b: Write/end ran after the socket closed. Guard destroyed/closed, or recreate the connection. Distinct from ERR_STREAM_WRITE_AFTER_END.

err: Error [ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED]: dlopen failed

fix.b: A native .node addon failed to load (wrong ABI, missing .so, or musl vs glibc). Rebuild the addon for this Node. Distinct from ERR_UNKNOWN_BUILTIN_MODULE.

err: Error [ERR_STREAM_DESTROYED]: Cannot call write after a stream was destroyed

fix.b: The writable was destroyed then written. Check destroyed/writable, or pipeline a new stream. Distinct from ERR_STREAM_WRITE_AFTER_END.

err: Error: You are attempting to export generateMetadata from a component marked with <STR>. This is not allowed.

err: You're importing a component that needs useRouter. It only works in a Client Component but none of its parents are marked with <STR>

err: can't load package: package .: found packages foo and main in .

err: package foo is not in std

err: error: The following untracked working tree files would be overwritten by checkout

fix.b: Untracked files collide with the target tree. Move/remove them, or checkout with force only if disposable. Distinct from local changes overwritten by merge.

err: git: lfs is not a git command. See <STR>.

err: Error: locator.click: Element is outside of the viewport

err: Error: net::ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT at <URL>

err: Error: net::ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR at <URL>

err: Error: net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR at <URL>

err: Error: MCP error -<N>: Method not found: logging/message

err: Error: MCP error -<N>: Method not found: notifications/cancelled

fix.b: notifications/cancelled is a notification, not a request. Send it as a notification, or ignore if the peer does not track cancels. Distinct from ping.

err: RuntimeError: Event loop is closed

fix.b: Work was scheduled on a loop that already closed (asyncio.run returned). Keep the loop alive or create a new one. Distinct from no running event loop.

err: RuntimeError: Task got Future attached to a different loop

fix.b: The Future/Task was created on another loop (nested asyncio.run, or a worker thread). Use one loop, or loop.call_soon_threadsafe. Distinct from Event loop is closed.

err: json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line <N> column <N> (char <N>)

fix.b: json.loads got empty or non-JSON input (HTML error page, BOM, or truncated body). Check status/content-type before parse. Distinct from Unexpected token JSON.parse.

err: RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded

err: sqlite3.IntegrityError: UNIQUE constraint failed: users.email

err: error TS2769: No overload matches this call.

fix.b: None of the overloads accept these arguments. Match an overload's params, or add a new overload. Distinct from TS2345 single-signature mismatch.

    return bytes([t, 0x80 | n]) + len(v).to_bytes(n, "big") + v
